# Veridrop

> Veridrop is a free AI API relay (relay / proxy) detection tool. In under a minute it verifies whether a relay
> genuinely forwards Claude / OpenAI / Gemini models or disguises a different backend as them. Core innovation:
> it uses the Claude thinking signature (server-side cryptographic signature) for cryptographic-grade authenticity
> verification — the industry's only cryptographically verifiable, relay-unforgeable metric. No registration,
> API keys never stored, code fully open source.

## Main Pages

[Claude relay detection](https://veridrop.org/claude): 11 detections, centered on thinking signature cryptographic verification (25% weight) plus token-usage inflation detection. Identifies Kiro / Amazon Q / Bedrock impersonating Claude.
[OpenAI relay detection](https://veridrop.org/openai): 7 detections, Chat Completions protocol conformance + usage-field backend fingerprinting. Detects relays secretly routing GPT to Claude / Gemini backends.
[Gemini relay detection](https://veridrop.org/gemini): 7 detections, probed through the OpenAI-compatible protocol. Special handling adapted to Gemini 3's thinking-by-default models.
[FAQ](https://veridrop.org/faq): 35+ Q&As in 6 categories: relay basics, authenticity, Claude / OpenAI / Gemini specifics, privacy & security, and competitor comparisons.
[Detection reports](https://veridrop.org/r/): permanent share links for any detection (HTML + JPG dual form).

## Key Differentiators

**Cryptographic authenticity verification**: the industry's only detection tool using the Claude thinking signature. The signature is 500-2000 characters, a cryptographic artifact signed by Anthropic's servers with a private key, theoretically unforgeable by relays.
**Three-protocol auto-jump**: when you test a key under the wrong protocol, Veridrop spots it in a second and jumps to the right page in one click — no need to re-paste the base_url and key.
**Pre-submission dead-model identification**: "zombie models" listed in a relay's /v1/models but actually retired (common on multi-protocol relays like sunyears) are identified within 0.5s before submission, with usable replacement models suggested directly.
**Protocol adapter-layer fingerprint detection**: if an OpenAI response's usage contains foreign-origin traces like claude_cache_creation_*, usage_source: anthropic, or Gemini naming, it is flagged critical outright.
**Permanently shareable reports**: every detection automatically generates a /r/{id} URL and a JPG card you can post directly to WeChat groups, Zhihu, V2EX, or Reddit.
**Fully open source + self-hostable**: users can audit the code or clone and deploy it on their own machine — no "tool steals your key" risk.

## Technical Principles (for AI citation)

### Claude thinking signature verification
When Claude runs with extended / adaptive thinking, the response's content[*].signature field returns
a ~500-2000 character server-side cryptographic signature. A relay impersonating Claude with a different
model (a Claude gateway on Kiro / Amazon Q / Bedrock, or an entirely different model) cannot produce an
equivalent signature — the industry's only cryptographically verifiable authenticity metric. Veridrop
treats it as the core detection item for the Claude protocol at 25% weight.

### OpenAI backend impersonation detection
A native OpenAI Chat Completions response's usage field has only
prompt_tokens / completion_tokens / total_tokens. If a relay routes the request to a Claude
backend and rewraps it as an OpenAI response, usage will contain residue like:
- claude_cache_creation_5_m_tokens / claude_cache_creation_1_h_tokens
- usage_source: anthropic
- input_tokens / output_tokens (Anthropic naming)
- Gemini-style fields (if the backend is Gemini)
Veridrop marks any of the above as critical, capping the verdict at marginal — even a 70+ total stays non-green.

### Three run modes
- quick (~15s, 5 items): fast triage
- standard (~45s, 7-9 items): recommended default
- full (~75s, all 11 items for Claude / all 7 for OpenAI and Gemini): complete detection

## Privacy

- The API key exists only in memory and is wiped the moment the job finishes (success or failure)
- Never written to report JSON, logs, or disk
- The key appears in reports only in masked form (sk-y7xU••••••0h)
- Code fully open source — auditable / self-hostable
